bugs.name: The Categories empty-search state has the ungrammatical copy “No categories to found.”
bugs.summary: The Categories empty-search state has the ungrammatical copy “No categories to found.”
bugs.expected: The empty state should use grammatical copy such as “No categories found.”
bugs.actual: The empty-state message reads “No categories to found.”
reproSteps: Open /categories/ in the signed-in Saleor Dashboard.
Open the Saleor Dashboard as an administrator and navigate to Catalog > Categories.
Enter a unique search term that matches no category and press Enter.
bugs.reason: Rejected for the pinned Saleor dashboard fixture (source commit a6e7bee68ab183147ec680e03e86c29f717a11d5): CategoryListDatagrid uses the English default message No categories found. A fresh browser search for a unique nonexistent category displayed that exact grammatical message, not No categories to found.
